message: A data store name as "dataSource" works from core 6.8.0 only; pass $this->dataStore("name"), which works in every version.
CalculatedColumn string expressions fail on text values before core 6.8.1. Use function ($row) { ... }, which works in every version.
A formatValue string fails on text values before core 6.8.1. Use function ($value, $row) { ... }, which works in every version.
Query builder aggregates take columns only; a second argument is a second column. Use ->sum("col")->alias("name").
exportToXLSX() belongs to BigSpreadsheetExportable; with ExcelExportable use exportToExcel(...)->toBrowser("file.xlsx").
exportToCSV() and exportToJSON() come from the trait \koolreport\excel\CSVExportable (not ExcelExportable); add "use \koolreport\excel\CSVExportable;" to the report class.

Excel export templates are read as
...
; elements produce an empty workbook (an exception from excel 12.0.2).
MySQLDataSource ignores "connectionString" before core 6.8.1 ("No database selected"). Use host/dbname/username/password, or drop "class" to use PdoDataSource with the connection string.
Before core 6.8.0 a column "footer" is not rendered unless "showFooter" => true is set.
koolreport/d3 before 1.7.2 draws nothing for CSS widths such as "100%"; use pixels, e.g. "width" => 600.
Morris charts need jQuery loaded in the page <head> first; the widget does not load it.
Sparklines take one series with "column" => "name"; before sparklines 1.5.1 "columns" is ignored and the first column is charted.
StringCase takes case => columns: array("upper" => "name"). The column => case form works from core 6.8.1 only.
RowNumColumn takes the column name and the first number: new RowNumColumn("rank", 1). array("rank" => 1) works from core 6.8.1 only.
NumberRange ranges are array(from, to) with null for an open end, e.g. "low" => array(null, 50000); operators such as array("<", 50000) match nothing.
Join processes are not piped into: build them from both sources, $join = new Join($left, $right, array("leftKey" => "rightKey")), then $join->pipe(...).
FillNull takes "newValue" and "targetColumns"; the column => value shorthand works from cleandata 1.7.0 only.
